findings.title: Condition bindings are incorrectly treated as class names
findings.body: For `const active = mode === "advanced";` followed by `className={active ? "ux-row" : ""}`, the new binding traversal collects "advanced" and rejects it as an off-catalogue class. Neither branch can produce that class, so a valid migrated component now fails the required check.
findings.fix: Distinguish condition expressions from expressions that supply class values, and add a regression test for a locally bound condition containing a string comparison.

checklist.result: The targeted shell and badge fixes are present; the expanded checker introduces a false rejection.
Mutation updates serialize the reported resize/preference pair, but a remaining snapshot-based settings writer leaves F1 partially unresolved.
Queue commits follow successful persistence; rejected writes leave committed state intact. No persisted schema changes in these fixes.
A failed queued write rejects its caller and does not block subsequent writes.
Added event listeners and observers have cleanup; no process lifecycle changes.
Settings IPC shapes remain unchanged; the dynamic scope uses workspace-keyed adoption status.
The remaining whole-object save can still overwrite fields committed by an earlier queued mutation.
Queue tests cover mutation ordering and rejection, but omit the remaining replacement writer; checker tests omit locally bound string-comparison conditions.
Shared dialog-stack integration handles the reported nested editor; Build & release receives its dynamic scope badge.
No shared-definition parsing or writing changes.

earlierFindings.reason: Resize and draft updates now merge correctly, but DiscussionModal.tsx:266 still passes a captured whole settings object to save(), whose queued replacement at settingsStore.ts:261 can overwrite an in-flight resize or preference update; migrate this remaining writer to update().
Settings, SwarmTemplateEditorModal and AgentForm now use useDialogFocus, which traps Tab and gives the top visible dialog ownership of Escape.
SettingsOverlay passes entryScope(shown, ctx) into the page header, selecting Repository for Build & release when the active workspace's adoption status reports a shared definition.

verificationGaps: Tests, builds and PPVP were not run, as requested; conclusions are based on source inspection.
Interactive focus, resize persistence, Row measurements and theme rendering were not verified in the running app.
